facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's electronic payment and collection unit head says governance of the linkage between the Electronic Payment and Collection Centre and the Government Financial Management Information System (GFMIS) is being strengthened.

facts.fact: Finance Minister Mohamed Maait says the e-payment service for government employees' payrolls grew 24% to EGP 299.4 billion in July 2023 to May 2024.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance reports government e-payment and collection services at EGP 2.5 trillion in July 2023 to May 2024, up 19%, including a government online payment gateway collecting over EGP 1 billion.
Minister Maait says electronic customs collections reached EGP 284.3 billion and electronic tax collection transactions about EGP 613.1 billion in July 2023 to May 2024.
The Ministry of Finance gives EGP 2.5 trillion of e-payment and collection for July 2023 to May 2024, with electronic tax collection of EGP 613.1 billion and customs collection of EGP 284.3 billion.
